More than 100 years ago, space distortions appeared all over the world, and countless mysterious places came, and incredible creatures such as Pokémon also followed.

This creature possesses various magical supernatural abilities.

Even the weakest Pokémon can use these supernatural abilities to kill a full-grown man with ease.

Fueled by emotions of fear and greed, war broke out between humans and Pokémon.

however.

Even if the armies of various countries dispatch a large number of planes and artillery to carry out saturation bombing, the decline cannot be restored.

"The Pokémon in this world are a bit ridiculously strong, right?!"

Luo Yu couldn't help muttering, and his heart was also very shocked.

In the Pokémon anime he watched in his previous life, the power of Pokémon was far less exaggerated.

There is no such thing as a Legendary Pokémon at all.

But in this world, the power of a move released by any Elite Four-tier Pokémon could rival that of a tactical missile.

Under such circumstances, it was quite normal for the human army to lose at that time, and it was strange to win.

According to historical records, after the defeat, the human beings learned from the pain and decided to unite to find a way to subdue and control the Pokémon, and use the Pokémon to defeat the Pokémon.

After the cooperative research of scientists from various countries, human beings successfully used the berries found in the secret world to invent the Poké Ball that can subdue the Pokémon.

Since then, the profession of Pokémon Trainer has officially entered the stage of history.

Subsequently, various countries also began to form Pokémon Leagues to promote the development of the profession of Pokémon Trainers.

Pokémon have integrated into human civilization at an extremely fast speed.

Today, Pokémon have occupied a very important position in human civilization.

The Pokémon Trainer also represents the military strength of this country and has an extremely lofty status.

Hydro Pump had successfully reached the Proficient stage, and the move's modification was complete.

According to research published by Great Xia Pokémon League scholars, move proficiency could be divided into five stages: Beginner, Proficient, Expert, Master, and Perfected.

At Beginner, a Pokémon had only just learned the move and might still fail to execute it.

At Proficient, it could use the move reliably, understood its basic principles, and could begin adapting it to different purposes. Ash's Counter Shield from the anime was one example.

Expert and Master represented progressively deeper understanding of the move's principles.

Once a Pokémon mastered every aspect of a move, it reached the Perfected stage.

At this level, the Pokémon's use of this move will become instinctive like hands and feet.
